## Status

Obsolete as written. The claimed Debug-text product-wait sort no longer exists: current product waits use typed SemanticOrd. Removing that order now would contradict the current fact-engine contract while type interning and keep-first merges still expose execution order.

fz-kdt.48 owns denotational identity, exact row confluence and the post-cutover audit of execution-order sorts. Any sort whose only remaining purpose is raw interner or keep-first sensitivity is deleted there or recorded from the then-current final model. Do not implement this ticket against the stale premise.
title: Obsolete: Debug-sorted product waits no longer exist
